# Trading Direkt 2026-09-11 | Joakim Bornold om marknadssentimentet och valalternativen, Tobbe med TA

**Feed**: trading-direkt  
**Published**: 2026-09-11  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Guest Joakim Bornold (Aktieprofilen) described Swedish investor sentiment as calm and 'lagom'. He named the rising US 10-year yield and the unresolved Iran/Middle East conflict as the main drags on risk appetite. He expects Sunday's Swedish election to have no effect on the stock market, sees Stockholm as not expensive given an improving economy, and picked SEB as his one concrete idea. In the technical-analysis segment, Tobbe Rosén was short-term cautious on indices because of the rising VIX, a US 10-year yield near 5% and a likely Fed hike. He was still positive on a longer horizon and liked several stocks, including ITAB, Truecaller, Hansa Biopharma, Ambea and Micron.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SEB-A — SEB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest's pick for 10k SEK: cheap at P/E 13-14, good earnings and dividend, AI efficiency gains, improving economy and slightly higher rates.

#### Reasoning

Guest Joakim Bornold expects the economy to strengthen, rates to tick up and AI to bring big efficiency gains. He sees banks as winners and SEB as cheap at P/E 13-14 with solid earnings and dividend. His conviction is clear, though he answered half-jokingly ('Svårare än så').

#### Sell Triggers

- if economic recovery stalls
- if rates fall sharply compressing margins
- if AI efficiency gains fail to materialise

> *"SEB, PE, 13, 14. Är inte det rätt billigt eller? Tjäna bra, bra utdelning. Gynnas enormt av AI om de använder det rätt."*

---

### 🟢 ITAB — ITAB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Extremely positive reversal in value zone, bullish meeting line, bounce on standard line and MA20; TA host positive.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe Rosén's short-term screen flagged ITAB with several positive technical signals at once. He says he is positive but wants a strong close above the prior day's high before entering. A fall below 16.30 would risk a move to MA200.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price falls back below 16.30
- if price heads to MA200

> *"Så att jag är positiv till ITAB. Sen är det ju frågan om hur man ska tajma entrén."*

---

### 🟢 TRUE-B — Truecaller | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Medium-term momentum pick; strong last quarter, non-parabolic trend, pullback to fill gap seen as entry opportunity.

#### Reasoning

Truecaller came through the TA host's momentum screen: stocks strong last quarter tend to stay strong next quarter. The trend is intact and not parabolic, and the small pullback to fill the gap offers an entry. He is 'väldigt påtagligt positiv' for the next few months.

#### Sell Triggers

- if trend turns clearly down over coming weeks
- if gap fill turns into deeper decline

> *"positiv till True Caller på medellång sikt, några månader då är jag för tillfället."*

### 🟢 HNSA — Hansa Biopharma | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

After false breakout, price testing Fib38/standard line with narrow Bollinger bands; host clearly positive, entry on continuation close.

#### Reasoning

The TA host is 'tydligt positiv' to Hansa Biopharma. He wants buyers to return before Fib50 (~39) breaks. His entry is a strong close above the prior day's high in the upper third, with a stop just under the last two days' lows, which gives a better risk/reward than buying a breakout.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Fib50 (~39 SEK) is punctured
- if price breaks below last two days' lows after entry

> *"Så jag är tydligt positiv till Hansa Biofarma."*

### 🟢 MU — Micron Technology | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Ascending triangle against horizontal resistance, MACD positive cross above zero; host clearly positive.

#### Reasoning

On the chart, higher lows into horizontal resistance form an ascending triangle, and stochastic MACD has turned up above zero. The TA host expects a break higher and is clearly positive. Note that the stock fell with chip names in the market update.

#### Sell Triggers

- if ascending triangle fails with lower low
- if chip sector selloff deepens

> *"Så jag tror det är goda förutsättningar för att Micron Technology kommer dra vidare upp över de här nivåerna. Så jag är tydligt positiv till aktien."*

### 🟠 AMBEA — Ambea | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host very positive to stock with positive volume balance, but negative divergence suggests deeper pullback first; timing not ideal.

#### Reasoning

The host says he is 'mycket positiv' and expects further gains. Overbought momentum with negative divergence suggests a pullback toward gap support and a continuation formation first, so entry timing now is poor. Name is inferred from the 'en bea' transcription.

#### Sell Triggers

- if gap support fails
- if volume balance turns negative

> *"Jag är mycket positiv till aktien vill jag poängtera."*

### 🟠 SFAST — Stenhus i Norden | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Screen pick: respected rising MA200, breaking falling resistance; wait for MA100/MA50 pass with continuation formation.

#### Reasoning

Price tested and held a rising MA200 and is breaking a falling resistance line, which can lead to a powerful move. The host calls it 'jätteintressant' but wants MA100 and MA50 passed with a positive continuation formation before taking a position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price breaks below MA200
- if MA50/MA100 rejected

> *"Så det här läget tycker jag är jätteintressant."*

### 🟠 HTRO — Hexatronic | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Bollinger squeeze, very low volatility, charging for breakout; entry on strong close above ~39.70, stop ~37.60.

#### Reasoning

Volatility is as low as in October 2025, and the host expects a squeeze resolution. He would act on a strong close above ~39.70 with a tight stop around 37.60, then add if it breaks out. He calls it neutral right now but clearly interesting for upside on a longer view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price breaks below ~37.60
- if squeeze resolves downward without recovery

> *"Men Hexatronic tycker jag ser intressant ut på kort och medellång sikt."*

### 🟠 ALZCUR — Alzecure Pharma | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Up ~600% since June, overbought at tough resistance with negative divergence; pullbacks buyable, don't chase breakout.

#### Reasoning

The host sees it as technically overbought in a 7.75-9 SEK resistance zone that has triggered selling before, with negative momentum divergence. Pullbacks absorbed by buyers before a new lower low would be buyable. Chasing a breakout offers poor risk/reward.

#### Sell Triggers

- if pullback creates significant new lower low
- if resistance zone rejects again

> *"Så sammanfattningsvis jag skulle vilja säga att den är tekniskt överköpt. I ett tufft motståndsområde."*

### 🟠 ALBBV — Ålandsbanken | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Trading in range with choppy moves; rising volume balance near resistance makes it worth monitoring.

#### Reasoning

While the stock stays in its range, the host expects choppy moves. Volume balance rises as price nears resistance, which he finds interesting to monitor, but there is no entry call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if range breaks down

> *"Så det är absolut intressant att hålla koll på."*

### ⛔ MSTR — Strategy Inc | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Testing MA200 after bottom formation; host still weakly negative unless MA200 passes and higher lows continue.

#### Reasoning

The bottom formation and ascending triangle played out, and price is now testing MA200. The host remains 'svagt negativ' but says a pass above MA200 with continued higher lows could set up a 1-2-3 pattern with a 78% chance of new highs.

#### Sell Triggers

- if MA200 is decisively passed with higher lows (thesis invalidated)

> *"Jag är. Svagt svagt negativ till Strategy."*

### 🔴 ASKER — Asker | **SELL** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Cited analyst: DNB Carnegie cut from buy to sell, target 105→60 SEK; stock fell 19% to 58 SEK.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view, not the hosts'. DNB Carnegie made a double downgrade from buy to sell and cut its target price by over 40%, triggering a 19% drop.

#### Sell Triggers

- if broker reverses downgrade
- if earnings outlook improves

> *"DNB Carnegie har sänkt sin rekommendation för asker hela vägen från köp till sälj. Riktkursen kapas från 105 till 60 kronor"*

---

### 🟢 ACAD — AcadeMedia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Cited analyst: Nordea initiates with buy, TP 130 SEK; market overestimates Swedish political risk.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view. Nordea argues the market overestimates Swedish political risk and underestimates AcadeMedia's stable, mainly public-funded earnings, growing international diversification and acquisition capacity. Its 130 SEK target compares with a 99.20 SEK share price, and the CEO cites international growth after 7 acquisitions.

#### Sell Triggers

- if election outcome changes school funding rules
- if acquisitions fail to deliver

> *"Banken har inlett bevakning av aktien med köprekommendation och riktkursen 130 kronor."*

---

### 🟢 VBG-B — VBG | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analyst: ABG Sundal Collier initiates with buy, target 410 SEK; shares up 6% to 322.50.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view. ABG initiated coverage with a buy and a 410 SEK target, implying about 27% upside from 322.50 SEK.

#### Sell Triggers

- if broker cuts recommendation

> *"ABG Sundahl Collier som har inlett bevakning av verkstadsföretaget VBG med en köprekommendation"*
